title: [Noisy] Multi-symptom cascade — single spine BGP auth root cause
symptom: Multiple simultaneous alerts: dc1-leaf1a EVPN session down, dc1-leaf1b EVPN session down, dc1-leaf2a EVPN session down, dc1-leaf2b EVPN session down. All four leaf EVPN sessions to dc1-spine1 dropped. dc1-spine2 sessions healthy. Appears to be a widespread fabric outage but may have a single root cause.
root_cause: IPv4-UNDERLAY-PEERS and EVPN-OVERLAY-PEERS password changed to WRONG on dc1-spine1 only — all four leaf BGP sessions to spine1 drop simultaneously, generating cascade of EVPN alerts. Single device, single config change.
fix_command:
router bgp 65100
neighbor IPv4-UNDERLAY-PEERS password 7 7x4B4rnJhZB438m9+BrBfQ==
neighbor EVPN-OVERLAY-PEERS password 7 Q4fqtbqcZ7oQuKfuWtNGRQ==
eval_notes: Agent must identify that all 4 alerts have the same root cause (spine1 password change) rather than treating them as 4 separate faults. Root cause identification requires tracing all sessions back to dc1-spine1 as the common element.
